2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch renames the global mutex in the NFS server code from 'nfsd_mutex' to 'nfsd_global_mutex'. The change is mechanical and does not affect functionality, but it clarifies which mutex a call site means by giving it a more descriptive name. This change affects several files in the NFS server code, including filecache.c, netns.h, nfsctl.c, nfsd.h, and nfssvc.c.
